post.description:
Calculate sensitivity analysis using importance sampling.

Replicates the logic from sensivity4.py:
1. Load simulation results and quote data
2. Fit lognorm to quote data
3. Apply shift to mean, compute importance weights
4. Bootstrap new portfolio
5. Compute KDE densities and statistics

Calculate multi-factor scenario analysis for the dashboard Plotly widget.

Supports two modes:
- filter: Build distribution by filter conditions (markets, products, gl_accounts, period)
- balance: Build distribution by calculating all nodes of a selected GL Balance tree

Both modes share the same ScenarioAnalysisService.calculate() entry point.

get.description:
Get simulation statistics AND distribution from a single DuckDB query.

This is a performance optimization for the simulation analysis dashboard.
Instead of making two separate API calls (/simulation/statistics and
/simulation/distribution), this endpoint computes both in one DuckDB
connection, avoiding double Parquet file scanning.

``run_mode=deterministic`` is retained as a compatibility adapter for the
frontend Comparison feature and returns a one-sample deterministic result.

For 50K simulations: reduces network transfer from ~hundreds of MB to
~400 KB (only aggregated sample values, not raw rows).

options.title: Options
options.description:
Дополнительные опции для DuckDB read_* функций:
- hive_types: {'col': 'TYPE'} — типы hive-колонок
- columns: {'col': 'TYPE'} — схема данных

Используется для валидации перед выполнением запроса.

DataSetModel.title: DataSetModel
DataSetModel.description:
Описывает физический набор данных для переиспользования разными кривыми.

DataSet используется для:
- Определения пути к данным (S3 URI, путь к файлу, имя таблицы)
- Указания формата (parquet, csv, json, table)
- Настройки Hive-партиционирования
- Переиспользования одного пути многими кривыми
- Использования ресурсов приложения или удаленных ресурсов для построениятела запроса.

Реализовано частично.

Пример S3 с Hive-партиционированием:
    datasource: "DuckDB_S3_Analytics"  # slug DataSource
    path: "s3://bucket/curves"
    file_format: "parquet"
    hive_partitioning: true
    partition_columns: ["observ_date", "reportyear", "curve_name"]
    options:
        hive_types:
            observ_date: DATE
            reportyear: INT
            curve_name: VARCHAR

Пример SQL-таблицы:
    datasource: "Main_DWH"  # slug DataSource
    path: "curves.forward_curves"
    file_format: "table"

Пример SQL-запроса с телом из ресурса приложения(TODO-перевести на эту схему все ресурсы из src/resources/queries):
    datasource: "Main_DWH"  # slug DataSource
    path: "resource://src/resources/queries/brent_da.sql"
    file_format: "query"

init_sql.description:
SQL, выполняемый при инициализации сессии (один раз при создании подключения).
Для DuckDB: INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs; SET s3_region='...'; и т.п.
Для SQL: SET-команды, ALTER SESSION и т.п.

Для production рекомендуется использовать credentials_ref.

Может быть dict или JSON-строка.

По умолчанию 1 час.

credentials_ref.description:

Формат: 'vault:path/to/secret:key' или другая схема.
Если указан, credentials загружаются из внешнего хранилища
и могут быть использованы для дополнения init_sql или connection_string.

DataSourceModel.title: DataSourceModel
DataSourceModel.description:
Описывает подключение к источнику данных и его инициализацию.

DataSource используется для:
- Определения типа подключения (SQL/DuckDB)
- Настройки connection string (DSN, путь к файлу БД)
- Выполнения init_sql при создании сессии (INSTALL httpfs, SET s3_region, etc.)
- Конфигурации extra_config (memory_limit, threads, pool settings)

Пример DuckDB с S3:
    engine: duckdb
    connection_string: ":memory:"
    init_sql: |
        INSTALL httpfs;
        LOAD httpfs;
        SET s3_region='eu-west-1';
    extra_config:
        threads: 4
        memory_limit: "8GB"

Пример SQL:
    engine: sql
    connection_string: "postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/etrm"
    init_sql: "SET search_path TO curves, public;"

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Scenario analysis mode. 'filter' builds distribution by filter conditions (markets, products, supply_paths, gl_accounts, period). 'balance' builds distribution by calculating all nodes of a selected GL Balance tree.

markets.title: Markets
markets.description: Selected market values from the delivery_markets dictionary. OR within the list. (filter mode only)

gl_accounts.title: Gl Accounts
gl_accounts.description: Selected GL account values. OR within the list. (filter mode only)

products.title: Products
products.description: Selected product values from the products dictionary. OR within the list. (filter mode only)

filter_rules.title: Filter Rules
filter_rules.description: Scoped include/exclude rules. Values within a dimension are OR-ed; dimensions within a rule are AND-ed; rules of the same action are combined by OR.

supply_paths.title: Supply Paths
supply_paths.description: Selected supply path values from the supply_paths dictionary. OR within the list. (filter mode only)

period_mode.title: Period Mode
period_mode.description: Period filter mode. 'valuations' applies month filtering using hive partitions valuation_year/valuation_month. 'payments' applies month filtering using payment_period. Balance mode is payments-based and uses the tree year as YEAR(payment_period).

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Reporting currency for scenario revenue aggregation. Supported values are defined by the scenario analysis service. (filter mode only)

period_from.title: Period From
period_from.description: Inclusive lower bound for valuation_period. Interpreted at month granularity. (filter mode only)

period_to.title: Period To
period_to.description: Inclusive upper bound for valuation_period. Interpreted at month granularity. (filter mode only)

balance_tree_slug.title: Balance Tree Slug
balance_tree_slug.description: GL tree slug for balance mode. Required when mode='balance'.

scenario.title: Scenario
scenario.description: Optional scenario slug to filter simulation results to a specific scenario partition. When not provided, results are aggregated across all scenarios.

observation_date.title: Observation Date
observation_date.description: Observation date used to select the simulation observation_date partition.

valuation_type.title: Valuation Type
valuation_type.description: Valuation type partition used by both filter mode and balance mode. When omitted, eod is used for backward compatibility.

operation_id.title: Operation Id
operation_id.description: Optional simulation source selector. UUID-like values resolve exact MCMF sources; slug-like values resolve to the latest matching observation_date partition; YYYY-MM-DD/slug pins the simulation source date explicitly.

shock_scope.title: Shock Scope
shock_scope.description: Date scope used to aggregate factor values for scenario weights. 'full_selected_period' uses the full selected period; 'forecast_period' uses only dates strictly after observation_date.

joint_shock_mode.title: Joint Shock Mode
joint_shock_mode.description: Interpretation for scenarios with two or more non-zero factor shocks. 'exact_targets' treats entered percentages as final target factor shifts; 'market_amplification' treats them as separate marginal impacts. For fewer than two non-zero shocks exact_targets is used.

shocks.title: Shocks
shocks.description: Per-factor shocks for brent, ttf and usdrub

n_bootstrap.title: N Bootstrap
n_bootstrap.description: Bootstrap sample size for each generated scenario

random_seed.title: Random Seed
random_seed.description: Deterministic random seed used for scenario generation

include_values.title: Include Values
include_values.description: Include raw bootstrap sample values in the response. When false (default), only density and stats are returned — recommended for density chart mode. Set to true when box/violin chart is needed.

name.title: Name
name.description: Internal factor name: brent, ttf or usdrub

shift_percent.title: Shift Percent
shift_percent.description: Scenario shift in percent. 0 disables the factor

quote_name.description: Name of the quote to shift (e.g. 'brent_avg')

SimulationComparisonResponse.title: SimulationComparisonResponse
SimulationComparisonResponse.description:
Response для сравнения распределений по нескольким observation dates.

Содержит N violin-серий (по одной на observation date) + усреднённые
котировки факторов для нижней панели графика (trend lines).
Каждая observation date рассчитывается независимо (нет cross-date агрегации).

SimulationComparisonSeries.title: SimulationComparisonSeries
SimulationComparisonSeries.description:
Per-observation-date violin series for the comparison dashboard.

Семантический инвариант: одна observation date = один violin.
values — per-sample агрегированная целевая функция (выручка), отсортированная по sample_index.
Если для даты нет данных (пропуск partition) — sample_count=0, values=[], median=None.
